Details:

2026 Labor Day ZF Challenge

The tournament will have an estimated 220 teams participating. The Labor Day ZF Challenge offers great competition for teams of all levels, experienced referees and a centralized tournament feel that includes a tournament village of vendors as well as a great area to sit and relax after taking in some great soccer.
